boards.school_name: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented South Dakota Mines traditions centered on Rocker Days, M Hill, and commencement.

cards.entity_name: M Day and Whitewashing of the M
cards.title: Whitewash the M
cards.subtitle: M Hill • Rocker Days
cards.notes: Follow the annual Rocker Days schedule to watch or join the organized whitewashing of the M at Hanson-Larsen Memorial Park.
cards.short_summary: The M Hill ritual anchors South Dakota Mines’ M Day observance.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines lists an M Day Picnic and Whitewashing of the M during Rocker Days; its history says the first M-Day was held in 1912 when the M was built on M-Hill.
cards.source_title: Journey Through Time: History and Traditions Explored
cards.access_notes: Check the annual Rocker Days schedule for participation details and location guidance.

cards.title: Senior-Frosh Picnic
cards.subtitle: Rocker Days • South Dakota Mines
cards.notes: Look for the Senior-Frosh Picnic on the Rocker Days program; it opens the homecoming week alongside other campus traditions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Rocker Days gathering connecting senior and first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ 2024 and 2025 Rocker Days coverage identifies the Senior-Frosh Picnic as part of the annual homecoming-week festivities.
cards.source_title: Mines Invites Community to Rocker Days Festivities
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Rocker Days schedule; event details can change each year.

cards.title: Paint the Town
cards.subtitle: Downtown Rapid City • Rocker Days
cards.notes: Watch for approved Rocker Days window-painting opportunities with downtown businesses and community organizations; use organizer-provided locations only.
cards.short_summary: Mines students mark homecoming by painting downtown windows.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines reported that students painted windows at businesses and community organizations throughout downtown Rapid City during Rocker Days.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Invites Community to Join in Rocker Days Celebration
cards.access_notes: Participate only through the Rocker Days organizers and participating businesses.

cards.title: Hang the M
cards.subtitle: Campus Arch • Rocker Days
cards.notes: Check the Rocker Days program for the Hanging of the M, historically scheduled at the Campus Arch after the Senior-Frosh Picnic.
cards.short_summary: A homecoming-week M display ritual at the Campus Arch.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ 2023 Rocker Days schedule listed the Hanging of the M at the Campus Arch immediately after the Senior-Frosh Picnic.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Ready to Celebrate Rocker Days
cards.access_notes: Confirm whether this item appears on the current Rocker Days schedule before going.

cards.title: Dorm Storm
cards.subtitle: Residence Halls and Greek Hill • Rocker Days
cards.notes: If scheduled, follow residence-life and event-organizer guidance for the School Spirit Dorm Storm rather than entering any restricted space.
cards.short_summary: A listed Rocker Days school-spirit event based around campus housing.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ 2023 and 2024 Rocker Days schedules listed School Spirit Dorm Storm at residence halls and Greek Hill.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Invites Community to Join in Rocker Days Celebration
cards.access_notes: Current scheduling and residence-hall access rules apply.

cards.title: Crown Rocker Days Royalty
cards.subtitle: Rocker Days • South Dakota Mines
cards.notes: Follow candidate announcements and attend the official coronation if it is scheduled; the university archives preserve M Day royalty records.
cards.short_summary: Rocker Days includes campaigns and a coronation for homecoming royalty.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ Rocker Days schedules include homecoming royalty candidate campaigns and coronation, while Devereaux Library documents M Day royalty photographs beginning in 1958.
cards.access_notes: Refer to the current Rocker Days schedule for the coronation venue and attendance information.

cards.title: Burning of the M
cards.subtitle: Rocker Days • Official pep-rally program
cards.notes: Observe this programmed homecoming activity only from designated event areas and follow all event-staff directions around the bonfire.
cards.short_summary: A documented Rocker Days program item paired with coronation and a pep rally.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ 2024 Rocker Days schedule listed a bonfire and Burning of the M as part of the coronation and pep-rally program.
cards.source_title: South Dakota Mines Invites Community to Join in Rocker Days Celebration
cards.access_notes: Observe only during the official event; do not approach fire-control areas.

cards.title: Run from Frosh to Freshman
cards.subtitle: O’Harra Stadium • Homecoming halftime
cards.notes: Check the homecoming game program for the traditional Frosh Run, held at halftime as first-year students make the transition to freshmen.
cards.short_summary: A halftime rite of passage during the homecoming football game.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ alumni magazine describes the traditional Frosh Run at homecoming halftime as the point when participants officially go from frosh to freshmen.
cards.access_notes: Participation and stadium admission arrangements are set through the current homecoming program.

cards.title: Parade Through Downtown
cards.subtitle: Downtown Rapid City • Rocker Days
cards.notes: Find the current parade route and start time through Rocker Days communications, then watch from public areas along the designated route.
cards.short_summary: A downtown parade brings Mines student groups and local businesses into homecoming week.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines’ 2025 Rocker Days schedule included a downtown parade with more than 30 local businesses and student groups taking part.
cards.source_title: Mines Invites Community to Rocker Days Festivities
cards.access_notes: The alumni office lists Rocker Days for September 19–26, 2026; check its updated schedule for parade details.

cards.title: Open Commencement with the Mace
cards.subtitle: Commencement procession • South Dakota Mines
cards.notes: Look for the ceremonial mace at commencement, where the faculty chair carries it in the academic procession that begins the ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A locally designed commencement symbol using Black Hills materials and Mines imagery.
cards.evidence_claim: South Dakota Mines says its ceremonial mace has marked the start of commencement for two decades and is carried in by the faculty chair as part of the academic procession.
cards.source_title: A Tradition Carried Forward: Ceremonial Mace Marks 20-Year Tradition at South Dakota Mines Commencement
cards.access_notes: Follow the university’s current commencement attendance and venue guidance.
